evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3476682 is a 482.12 USD online product-C purchase in billing region 264.0 on 2016-11-21 20:30:00. Card C07297-K1 is a mastercard debit owned by C07297.
Region 264.0 has 15 prior purchases on this card before the alert.
Device Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080 is also linked to 3 other card(s): C02354-K2, C07987-K2, C09933-K2.
Email domain gmail.com is present on the flagged purchase; email_fanout found 26 other cards, treated as too common for R6.
Billing region 264.0 appears on 17 other cards in the local 1-hop fan-out. Region sharing is recorded, not treated as proof of a shared origin.
Episode reconstruction grouped 5 transactions around 3476682 using history, device, amount outliers, and NEXT edges 3476665, 3477578.
Customer denied the purchase and still has the card.

R2 Customer denies: When the customer denies the transaction, recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE. Add FILE_REPORT when exposure exceeds 1000 USD, a shared device is present, or another card's fraud is connected.
Card-not-present fraud: Online activity inconsistent with the cardholder's normal merchants, amounts, or product codes. A burst of a few transactions within 48 hours is common.

Closed case CC-1925: Case CC-1925: cardholder C13171 reported unrecognized activity on card C13171-K2. 3 transaction(s) between 2016-08-08 and 2016-08-08 totaling $120.30 were confirmed fraudulent. Online purchases inconsistent with the cardholder's usual merchants and amounts. Card blocked and reissued. Customer reimbursed.

FFIEC authentication guidance: FFIEC guidance expects layered authentication. A new device or credential change on an online purchase is a reason to step up authentication, not automatic proof of fraud.

case.summary: HHG-006 is a customer_report alert on a 482.12 USD online purchase in billing region 264.0. Graph history shows 15 prior purchases in that region. Pattern is card_not_present_fraud; fraud probability 0.46. Episode size 5; exposure 1989.04 USD. Verdict is fraud.

sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21, card C07297-K1 belonging to customer C07297 was used for a 482.12 USD online transaction 3476682 in billing region 264.0, country 87.0. The product code was C. Episode reconstruction identified 5 related transaction(s) totaling 1989.04 USD from 2016-11-21 to 2016-11-22. Graph neighborhood review found this activity inconsistent with the cardholder's established pattern or linked it to a shared origin, email cluster, or mixed-channel takeover.  The investigation treated the purchase as unauthorized. Connected cards recommended for monitoring: C02354-K2, C07987-K2, C09933-K2. The flagged card is recommended for restriction pending reissue. Total unauthorized amount: 1989.04 USD. This report is filed so a regulator can review the episode on its own.
